svg.title: Crunch Num.2 dash reapplication
svg.desc: The repaired target montage and presentation-safe movement path produce an 1800 unit charge while collision and cancellation remain authoritative.

g.text: 2026-09-10 · runtime asset rollback and montage failure addressed
AM_Dash resolved to the reverted asset; logs showed wrong skeleton → PlayMontage failed → ability ended.
Num.2 → AM_Dash_Reapplied (target Crunch skeleton) + presentation-only montage task
Montage failure cannot cancel gameplay → GAS root-motion force → 1800 units / 0.6 s
CharacterMovement collision, authority damage ledger, watchdog and cleanup remain active
Validation: isolated Development build passed; Dash automation passed at 30/60 FPS (1800), wall (565), cancel (500).
Workspace editor binaries were locked, so the repaired asset uses a new package; restart/rebuild the open editor to load it.
